item.title: Lupin Q2 results: Net profit falls 22% to ₹1,155 cr, revenue at ₹7,827 cr
item.description: Homegrown pharma major Lupin on Wednesday posted a 22.19 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,155.30 crore in the September quarter, dragged down by an exceptional item. The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,484.83 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, it said in a regulatory filing to the exchanges. Revenue from operations was Rs 7,827.26 crore during the quarter under review, up from Rs 7,047.51 crore in the year-ago period, it said. Lupin's total expenses also rose to Rs 6,374.46 crore during the quarter from Rs 5,130.54 crore in the same period last year. During the April-September period in FY27, Lupin's net profit declined 4.95 per cent to Rs 2,572.28 crore from Rs 2,706.29 crore a year earlier, the filing said. During the six months ended September 30, 2026, Lupin Pharmaceuticals Inc USA, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Group, settled one of the ongoing antitrust matters for Rs 316.28 crore (USD 35.8 million) without admission
item.bs:keywords: Lupin Q2 results, Lupin Q2 FY27, Lupin net profit, Lupin revenue, pharmaceutical sector, US antitrust settlement, Lupin US sales, Nilesh Gupta

item.title: ED attaches 2 aircraft in probe against Reliance Anil Ambani Group
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate on Tuesday said it has attached assets worth Rs 510 crore, including two aircraft, as part of an alleged bank fraud-linked money laundering investigation against the Reliance Anil Ambani Group (RAAG). The probe is related to allegations against Reliance Home Finance Limited (RHFL)/Reliance Commercial Finance Ltd. (RCFL) of Rs 263.05 crore fraud and against Reliance Communication Ltd. (RCOM) for Rs 247.12 crore fraud. A provisional order has been issued under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) to attach the properties worth Rs 510 crore, it said. In the RCOM case, the attached assets include 2 chartered aircraft, 6 land parcels and an office premise in Maharashtra, the ED said in a statement. In the RHFL/ RCFL case, two wind mills in Tamil Nadu, bank balances, fixed deposits and investments have been attached, it added. The aircraft are a Dassault Falcon 2000 and an Embraer. item.title: Saudi Aramco Q3 net profit rises 35% on higher oil prices, stake sale
item.description: Majority state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco on Tuesday reported a 35 per cent increase in third-quarter net profit as earnings were boosted by higher oil prices and the sale of its stake in a Malaysian refining and petrochemical company. Net profit rose to USD 36.3 billion from USD 26.9 billion in the year-earlier quarter. Adjusted net profit, which leaves out the sale of a stake in PRefChem to Malaysian state oil company Petronas, rose 9 per cent to USD 31.2 billion. The company also benefitted from high profit margins at its refineries turning crude into useable products such as diesel fuel. Saudi Aramco sold its oil for an average of USD 95.20 a barrel during the quarter, compared to USD 70.10 in the year-before quarter, the company said in a news release. Oil prices surged after the outbreak of the Iran war due to disruption of supply and uncertainty about the course of the conflict. item.title: NTPC eyes to add 58 Gw of installed capacity reach 149 Gw by 2032: Chairman
item.description: NTPC, the country's largest power generation company, is gearing up to add 58 gigawatt of installed capacity to reach 149 gigawatt by 2032, its Chairman Gurdeep Singh said on Tuesday. The new capacities will be of various sources including renewables, Singh said addressing the KPMG ENRich 2026 event here. Speaking at a session, he also shared NTPC's plans for the nuclear sector. At present, NTPC has an installed power generation capacity of 91 gigawatt (GW), Singh said adding that by 2032, the company would be reaching 149 GW. "We have very clear direction...now going fast in nuclear capacity addition. Of the 250 GW capacity targeted for the year 2037, the plan of about 30 GW nuclear," Singh noted. NTPC has finished feasibility studies for proposed nuclear capacities in Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Odisha, and will scout for more locations in other states, as per sources. item.title: Pfizer Q2 results: Net profit rises 65.7% to ₹313 cr, income at ₹774 cr
item.description: Drugmaker Pfizer Ltd on Tuesday reported a 65.72 per cent increase in net profit to Rs 313.25 crore in the September quarter, driven by gains from exceptional items. The company had posted a profit of Rs 189 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, Pfizer said in a regulatory filing. Pfizer has accounted for exceptional gains of Rs 132.06 crore in the September quarter from its parent entity Pfizer Inc USA following the sale of Minipress XL. Consequent to the decision, Pfizer Ltd discontinued the manufacture of Minipress XL from September 7, 2026, according to the filing. Its profit before tax and exceptional items stood at Rs 290.77 crore during the quarter under review, up 13.86 per cent year-on-year. It was at Rs 255.37 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. item.bs:keywords: Pfizer Ltd, Q2 results, September quarter results, net profit, exceptional gains, Minipress XL, pharmaceutical companies, pharma earnings, BSE
